(ञ) चिञ् r. 1st, 5th and 10th cls. (चयति-ते चिनोति चययति or चपयति)
To collect, to gather together, to heap, to assemble, to accumulate, &c.
With अप,
To lose, to squander.
With उप or सम्,
To collect or acquire.
With निर्,
To determine.
With वि and निर,
To determine exactly.
(ईर ण) ईरचिण् r. 1st cl. (चयति)
To injure, (peculiar to the Vedas.)
